title: Internal: Freezing and Unfreezing a Debit Card
summary: This document provides the procedure to temporarily FREEZE or UNFREEZE a debit card, including required verification, card status checks (ACTIVE to freeze; FROZEN to unfreeze), and the exact actions freeze_debit_card_3892 and unfreeze_debit_card_3893 using card_id. It also explains effects while frozen (all new/recurring declined, pending may still process) and notes ATM access behavior, separate 'ATM Block' setting, and the 90-day reminder.
faqs: How is FREEZE different from CLOSE for a debit card, and can freezing be reversed?
What requirements must be met before I can freeze a debit card (status/ownership/verification)?
What happens to new transactions, recurring payments, and pending authorizations while the card is frozen?
How do I unfreeze a debit card, and what conditions are required (FROZEN status and linked checking account OPEN)?
Does freezing affect ATM access, and what is 'ATM Block' in the mobile app?
If the card isn’t unfrozen within 90 days, what reminder will the customer receive?
